entries.name: Borne de caution
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production candidate raster prop for a side-view 2D fighting game.
Primary request: create ONE original civilian industrial object for Les Dettes de Nacre, a fan-created Mass Effect-compatible story set in the Terminus Systems in 2185. This is original fan content, not an official model reconstruction.
Style: grounded high-detail game-asset rendering with realistic hard-surface construction, matching worn ivory ceramic-composite panels, graphite structure, restrained copper trim and small cyan technical lights of a freight station. Practical bolts, vents and seams; controlled surface wear, readable silhouette, no extravagant ornament.
Composition: one completely assembled object centered, whole object including its base and every protrusion inside the frame with clear transparent margins. Eye-level orthographic or near-orthographic side / mild three-quarter view, no exaggerated perspective. Neutral soft studio lighting with a modest warm edge. True transparent RGBA background; crisp clean silhouette edges. No floor plane, environment, pedestal added solely for presentation, cast ground shadow, border, characters, logo, watermark or text. Do not create an exploded view, sprite sheet, multiple versions or detached component catalogue.
Only the assembled resting base object is requested; moving parts, other states and effects will be separate future files.

Subject: Borne de caution. Heavy pedestal control kiosk, narrow recessed receipt screen, closed physical sliding drawer and a cutoff shutter. The entire base and top are visible. Screen shows only abstract thin cyan bars without text.
Design constraints: Aucun texte complet dans le dessin ; les contrats restent du texte localisable de l'interface.
